svg.title: Prisma ORM Manifesto 2026: Open, Extensible, Collaborative
svg.desc: The Prisma mark above the headline "Prisma ORM Manifesto 2026", with three icons connected to it by prism-colored lines: a globe labeled Open, expanding arrows labeled Extensible, and a handshake labeled Collaborative. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand: paper surface, spectral prism wash, prism stripe motif.
